enactment_history.conflict_note: Secondary references differ on article ranges assigned to later volumes and on the number of articles counted in current versions. No definitive count or complete chronology is adopted until checked against original parliamentary/gazette records.

article_count_variance.note: These are counts reported by secondary reproductions/platforms and are not interchangeable. The corpus must preserve article-level identifiers and repeal/deletion status rather than infer a canonical count from page totals.
